description: Documented, reviewed exceptions for scripts/security/scan_artifacts.py (M30). Each entry must still match a finding, or the scan fails as stale. Paths are matched against '<scanned folder name>/<path inside it>'.

exceptions.reason: Third-party prebuilt binaries embed their upstream build machines' paths in debug and panic metadata: the python-build-standalone CPython runtime and its bundled OpenSSL, libffi and SQLite (C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Temp\...), and Rust-based PyPI wheels such as pydantic-core, rpds-py and cryptography (C:\Users\runneradmin\.cargo\...). They name no user or maintainer machine and contain no secrets; removing them would mean rebuilding upstream binaries.

FFmpeg and FFprobe embed their configure line and default data directory, which contain this repository's public GitHub Actions workspace path (/d/a/openworld-moments/...). No personal path or secret. The binaries were qualified on Windows 11 in M29; neutralising the build prefix needs a rebuild and requalification and is deferred to the M32 release build.
